html_source: Detail of 1904 Bartholomew map showing the intersection of Arbour Hill and Stoneybatter roads (orange), St. Michan's church (blue), the fish and produce markets (red), the Four Courts (black), the city courthouse (brown), and the locations of Barney Kiernan's pub (green) and the Linenhall Barracks (purple).
